ja447:1.1: Kiṃ te vataṃ kiṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ, kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko, akkhāhi me brāhmaṇa etam atthaṃ, kasmā hi tuyhaṃ daharā na mīyare ti.
ja447:2.1: Dhammaṃ carāma, na musā bhaṇāma, pāpāni kammāni vivajjayāma, anariyaṃ parivajjemu sabbaṃ, tasmā ti amhaṃ daharā na mīyare.
ja447:3.1: Suṇoma dhammaṃ asataṃ satañ ca, na cāpi dhammaṃ asataṃ rocayāma, hitvā asante na jahāma sante, tasmā --pe--.
ja447:4.1: Pubbe va dānā sumanā bhavāma, (J. III p. 300.) dadam pi ce attamanā bhavāma, datvāpi ce nānutappāma pacchā --pe--.
ja447:5.1: Samaṇe mayaṃ brāhmaṇe addhike ca vanibbake yācanake dalidde annena pānen' abhitappayāma --pe--.
ja447:6.1: Mayañ ca bhariyaṃ nātikkamāma, amhe ca bhariyā nātikkamanti, aññatra tāhi brahmacariyaṃ carāma --pe--. Etāsu ve jāyare suggavāsu medhāvino
ja447:8.1: honti pahūtapaññā bahussutā vedaguno ca honti --pe--.
ja447:9.1: Mātā pitā ca bhaginī bhātaro ca puttā ca dārā ca mayañ ca sabbe dhammaṃ carāma paralokahetu --pe--.
ja447:10.1: Dāsā ca dasso anujīvino ca paricārikā kammakarā ca sabbe dhammaṃ caranti paralokahetu tasmā ti amhaṃ daharā na mīyare ti
ja447:11.1: Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ, dhammo suciṇṇo sukham āvahāti, esānisaṃso dhamme suciṇṇe: na duggatiṃ gacchati dhammacārī.
ja447:12.1: Dhammo have rakkhati dhammacāriṃ chattaṃ mahantaṃ viya vassakāle, dhammena gutto mama Dhammapālo, aññassa aṭṭhīni, sukhī kumāro ti
